name: City of Pineville Elk River Access
facilities: Boat ramp, parking and privy shown on the MDC area map.
description: City-maintained Elk River access under an MDC cooperative agreement. Reach the parking area from Rhine Road; use the developed launch, not the highway bridge.
road_access: Reach the access via Route W and Rhine Road in Pineville.
parking_info: Use the developed parking area beside the city boat ramp, reached from Rhine Road.

name: Mount Shira Access
facilities: Gravel boat launch and large parking area. Camping is prohibited. Restrooms and an accessible trail were not verified.
description: MDC public access on the west bank of the Elk River, with a gravel boat launch and bank fishing. Camping is prohibited.
road_access: Highway 59, approximately 2 miles north of Noel.
parking_info: Large parking lot beside the gravel launch.

name: Sycamore Landing
facilities: Private River Ranch Resort campground with tent and RV areas, restrooms and showers.
description: A distinct campground near River Ranch in Noel. Operator map shows river access and a float landing; launch/landing coordinates and independent-boat arrangements remain to be verified. Campground business coordinates must not be substituted for an endpoint.

name: Cowskin Access
facilities: MDC boat ramp and parking at Highway 43. Camping is prohibited.
description: MDC public access on the lower Elk at Highway 43, with a concrete boat ramp and parking. Camping is prohibited.
road_access: Highway 43, approximately 8 miles north of Southwest City.
parking_info: Parking lot at the concrete boat ramp.

name: Kozy Kamp River Access
facilities: Private campground river access. Check in with the operator for parking and access arrangements.
description: Private campground on the north bank in Pineville, just west of the highway bridge. A campground track leads down to the water.
confidence: medium (owner-approved 2026-11-01; pin set by the owner)
fee_notes: Operator rental or paid river-access pass required; confirm current availability and terms.
